argon.why: P and R maintain consistent magma-to-crust proportions and smooth churning motion across all 4 animation frames while reading clearly as a sunken 3/4 pool in both cave palettes. verdict: redraw: break 32px row banding (spread lobe rows), crust as glowing-edged skin not shadowed slabs, smaller sway, less speckle
